en.html:
The Ootori main residence at Sasagawa was vast. From the front gate to the inner residence, there must have been several kilometers.
At this rate, however, even that was going to take no time.

That they knew the way was not mysterious. Unfamiliar ground for me; for the two Ootori women, <ruby>their own home<rt>home</rt></ruby>. Why should they not know its layout?
The speed, on the other hand, was not a matter I could dispose of by saying naturally.
A hundred kilometers an hour—or was it approaching a hundred and fifty?

At such speed, hardly any shaking. Admirable, one might begin to say, but by the end of it the proper word was abnormal.
The <ruby>famous car of an earlier age<rt>Prince Henry</rt></ruby> skimmed the earth like the wind itself.

The guards along the way could only watch this highborn runaway vehicle pass. Even the occasional quick-thinking unit that spread out to block us—

Kageaki"This is not a thing to do."
Sayo"Not possible to defend it, certainly."
Kanae"It really isn't."
Kageaki"............"
Kageaki"If every one of us thinks so, how did we arrive at a plan for breaking in through the front?"
Sayo"Through the course of events, I believe."
Kanae"Perhaps because we reached Sasagawa while we were still considering the plan?"
Kageaki"Even so, arriving here did not supply a reason to drive straight into it, surely..."
Sayo"Entirely correct. Such wisdom, Mr. Minato, you must share a little earlier. Otherwise how are we to benefit?"
Kanae"Exactly. Really, what are we to do with you?"
Kageaki"..................I shall keep that in mind."
